bends.note: curves east with the canal at the foot of the sheet and becomes the W.N. Canal roadway of West Central Parkway

notes: Canal corridor (overprinted CENTRAL PARKWAY) between West Plum Street (printed '(W. PLUM)', 55 ft, centre x 1195 at the top drifting to 1220 at Charles) and East Plum Street (printed '(E. PLUM)', 55 ft at the top; '44'' near the south end where the canal widens from 41 to 50 ft). Plum centres are the midpoint between the lot line and the canal bank, which matches the water-pipe lines; E. Plum centre moves from x 1530 (14th to Grant) to 1542 (12th) and 1565 (Charles) as the canal bank moves east, treat as +/-15. West 14th: west of the canal 40 ft (centre from the south line, north line is off the paper), east of the canal printed 50 ft; the two legs are offset ~20 px and joined only by a FOOT BRIDGE, so they are T's. West 12th crosses the canal on an IRON BRIDGE, so both Plum crossings are marked cross (on sheet 64 the bridge is hidden under the pasted parkway strip). Laurel and Ann come in from sheet 64 west of W. Plum only. Grant (40 ft) runs E. Plum to Elm only. Charles is 40 ft west of the canal and printed 31' east of it (legs offset ~25 px); it ends at Elm. Schutt Alley label is partly covered by a paste-over ('SCHUT...'); spelling assumed Schutt. Emerson printed 'EMERSON' (10 ft, 4" W.P.), 12th to Charles; Alley suffix assumed by width. The unnamed 10 ft alley from Grant to 12th (x 2490) is its continuation north of 12th, so Emerson/12th is a cross; Schutt Alley ends at that alley. Unnamed 10 ft E-W alley between 12th and Charles runs from E. Plum to Elm and crosses Emerson at about (2490, 3658). Unnamed 10 ft N-S alley south of Charles (x 2248) runs to the north line of West Central Parkway (y ~4447). West Central Parkway (printed 'W. CENTRAL (W.N. CANAL) PARKWAY') lies along the foot of the sheet: only its north line (y ~4447) and part of the 48 ft W.N. Canal roadway are on the paper; the 146 ft corridor centre (used on sheet 56) is off the sheet, so Elm/West Central Parkway is not recorded. The covered driveway in block 1 between Music Hall and Floral Hall (y ~1335, '6" W.P.') is inside the Exposition block, not a street. Street suffixes not printed (ELM, GRANT, CHARLES, LAUREL, ANN); 'Street' assumed.
